source_text.body:
Build and run an affiliate marketing site with sub-agents
Author used an agent with specialised sub-agents to build and operate a 729-page affiliate site, reporting $1,422 revenue in 30 days, reviewing public work and approving releases.
·
Nov 26, 2026
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
Anfernee gave a Grok Bot agent an income target and constraints: no high-touch consulting and no course he would have to deliver himself. The agent built Agent Stories, a directory of sourced AI use cases, using specialised agents with defined jobs. Candidate stories were scored out of 25 on five criteria. Anfernee reviewed previews and approved releases before anything went live.
How it went
He bought the domain on 28 October, and the site was open to search engines two days later with 36 stories. By late November it had 200+ stories, 430+ skills and over 700 pages. The affiliate summary shows $1,422.75 in 30 days.
Worth knowing
The prompts and masterclass replay are paywalled. The revenue figure comes from the author's own affiliate summary, and the post doesn't give costs, so profit is unclear.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Build and run an affiliate site about [niche] using specialised sub-agents for research, writing, SEO and publishing. Draft the pages and a publishing plan, and show me each batch for approval before anything goes live or any affiliate account is signed up for. Each week, report pages published, traffic and revenue so I can review it.
Original source: https://solopreneurcode.substack.com/p/how-my-ai-built-and-runs-a-business
